theater_main_quest_02_06_04_019:

theater_main_quest_02_07_01_006:

Lili doesn't need a god to tell her.
Lili knows she was born for this very moment!
theater_main_quest_02_07_05_039:
All of Lili's mistakes were leading to this day!
Now it's Lili's turn to help them!
theater_main_quest_02_07_05_041:
Don't listen to her, Lord Soma!
We're under attack by another familia right now—
theater_main_quest_02_07_06_056: You jumped right at the opening...
theater_main_quest_02_08_01_015:

theater_main_quest_02_08_05_023: To hell with what Lord Apollo wants!
theater_main_quest_02_08_06_003:
When you're cornered, that's when

Lord Takemikazuchi, everyone...

 200 million, thrusting with 200 million,
 blocking with 200 million...)

You're right. It's all thanks to

Nah? Just thinking you've really

Familias of their own followers—

The children seek to challenge the endless
unknown. The gods spend their days in
search of amusement.

—This is the Labyrinth City, Orario.

More importantly, if you don't eat up,

A mage who froze up in front of monsters

Ais, listen to thiiis. Lefiya's being such a

I'm always the one being protected,

theater_main_quest_21_01_01_035:
Aaais. That's no good,

...Wh-waaaah, Ms. Ais is, she's...
she's patting my heeead!!

The captain's the one who decided

theater_main_quest_21_01_02_010: Ah, n-no, I didn't mean that at all...!!
theater_main_quest_21_01_02_014:
Ahh... C-Captain...!

Tione was bullying Lefiya and threatening

Ngggh, my chest has nothing to do with this!
What, just 'cause yours is all bouncy?!
theater_main_quest_21_01_02_019: What? Just 'cause yours is all flat?
theater_main_quest_21_01_02_021: That's enough. You're makin' a racket.
theater_main_quest_21_01_02_023:
Sibling squabbles aside, this expedition
starts in earnest from here.
I'm counting on you, Tione.

theater_main_quest_21_01_02_029: You're with me. We need to talk.
theater_main_quest_21_01_02_033:
She's such a pushover.

theater_main_quest_21_01_03_001:
You're still not used to fighting

theater_main_quest_21_01_03_003:
I know what to do, but when a monster

my mind just goes blank.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_004: You're inexperienced, but you have potential.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_005:
With your rare magic-focused ability and
your skill's support, your raw firepower
far surpasses a Level 3's.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_006:
That's exactly why we brought you
on this expedition. You understand that.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_009: You want to fight alongside Ais, don't you?
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_011:
Heh... Then all the more reason.
Overcome your fear and fulfill
your duty as a mage—
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_014:
Potential or whatever, I don't care.
I ain't gettin' dragged down by someone
who pisses herself over monsters.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_015: If you can't fight, get lost.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_018:
Shut it, hag! Quit coddlin' the trash.
As long as she's babblin' about dreams and
crap, trash'll stay trash forever.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_021:
Pay him no mind.
He's a man who can't speak any other way.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_023:
First you, and now Ais.
You're both quite a handful.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_025:
That girl carries burdens of her own,
different from yours.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_027:
About that last battle—why did you rush
ahead like that? My order was to hold
the front line.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_029:
Ais, you're strong. But we're not
fighting alone.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_030:
Others could be put in danger,
and your actions affect the Familia.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_031: I need you to keep that in mind.
theater_main_quest_21_01_03_033: Now, don't be so hard on her, Finn.

Ais probably charged into that pack of
Fomoire on purpose to lighten the load

Riveria said she might've taken too long

theater_main_quest_21_01_03_037:
Ais, this is the Dungeon. Anything
can happen. I just want you to keep
that in mind, at least.

But knowing there's a hellish place

a stomachache.

Only the captain and the other first-tier

least give them the best support we can.

Still, without safety point floors like this,
attacking the deep floors would be
impossible.

It's from the passage to the 51st floor.
Let's go, Lefiya!

No time to stand around, you idiot Amazons!
More are comin'!!

But what are we supposed to do

What she lacks is experience and a little

All right. We can't push on in this state

Begin your chant.
You're the one who will defeat that monster.

Airiel.

Ugh, so frustratiiing!

Give it a rest, will you?
How long are you gonna keep whining?

Whoa, what a weird color.

I just stuck my hand in

Bete, you're so annoying.

Captain, what should we do?

Wahahaha! Hahaha!

The expedition team has returned

WELCOOOOOOOOOME HOOOOOOOOOME!!

—Didn't your boobs get

theater_main_quest_21_02_02_035: As thanks... Should I do it again?

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_007:
Can't go cuttin' in front of

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_009:

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_010: —Ehehe. Never get tired of this view.
theater_main_quest_21_02_03_011:
Uh-oh, I'm a lil' tipsy, so there's a

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_014:

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_017:
...Oh, Ais, you can read 'em too,

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_024: ...Well, it's a road we've all walked.
theater_main_quest_21_02_03_025:

feel the urge to rush ahead.
theater_main_quest_21_02_03_026:

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_027:
Her desire to reach greater heights,

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_028: —Which means the next thing on her mind is—

It depends on the situation, but when

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_033:

brood over everything.

changing little by little.

theater_main_quest_21_02_03_038: She can't only think about herself, eh?
theater_main_quest_21_02_03_039: ...It can be a blessing at times, you know.
theater_main_quest_21_02_04_007:
Yes! I've been saving them.
Would you like one?
theater_main_quest_21_02_04_014:
Thank goodness!
Ms. Ais. I'm going to work hard so I can
be a help to you!
theater_main_quest_21_02_04_020:
Thank you, Lefiya.

theater_main_quest_21_02_04_026:
O-o-oh my gosh?! That's way too much
of an honor for me!
theater_main_quest_21_02_04_033:
(Operation: Cheer Up Ms. Ais—
I'll try even harder!)

I'd love to give something like this to

she'd be put off?

theater_main_quest_21_02_05_004:
...You jest. The quality is certainly good,

theater_main_quest_21_02_05_005:

If you jack the price up that much,

theater_ott_quest_03_01_01: —He had no name. No family name, either.

What the Sword Princess saw,

theater_ott_quest_03_02_09:
Hold nothing back. If you cannot even

theater_ott_quest_03_02_19:
A loser smeared in mud, unworthy

theater_ott_quest_03_02_20:
At your core, you've changed nothing

theater_ott_quest_03_02_21:
Defeat ground into you by the adventurers

theater_ott_quest_03_02_27:

theater_ott_quest_03_03_15:

theater_ott_quest_03_03_18:

With the sword whose name I received
